summary: Mega Fortune Co Ltd filed a 6-K disclosing board and officer changes effective January 2026. Four directors/officers resigned (independent directors PoTin Wong, Wan Kwun Lun, director/CFO Chi Chuen Lai, director/COO Sin Yi Cheng) without disagreement. Three successors were elected by remaining directors: Charles Lin as independent director, Chunyan Wang as independent director, and Longwai Lai as director/CFO. The resignations are abrupt but not explicitly forced. No other special-situation event is reported. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer update; confidence is medium because multiple simultaneous departures could signal governance activity, but no triggering event or deal is mentioned.
